description: Perps prop firms from their own pages: rules, each challenge's price after any live code, discount codes, country, platforms, assets, max allocation. Use when the user asks: crypto prop firm rules; X discount code; cheapest $50K challenge; prop firms in the UAE. Args: firm; rule; account_usd; country; asset; on_chain; max_price_usd.

account_usd.description: Only challenges of this account size in dollars (50000): each firm's challenges at that size, cheapest to get funded first (the price after any live code plus any fee due on passing), and the firm's offers that cover it.
account_usd.title: Account Usd

asset.description: Only firms that offer this asset class.
asset.title: Asset

country.description: Only firms based in this country: where the firm says it operates, else where its contracting company is registered (United Arab Emirates or UAE, United States or US, Cayman Islands).
country.title: Country

firm.description: One firm by name (Breakout, HyroTrader, Propr): its full record, every challenge and its dated rule changes. Unset: a short record per firm.
firm.title: Firm

max_price_usd.description: Only firms whose cheapest published evaluation costs this much or less, in dollars (100).
max_price_usd.title: Max Price Usd

on_chain.description: true: only firms whose trades execute on an on-chain venue.
on_chain.title: On Chain

rule.description: Only firms on one of OptimistFi's rule lists, by its slug.
rule.title: Rule

name: get_prop_firms
title: Prop firms for perpetual futures
